sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं भरतस्य महात्मन: ।भरद्वाज: शुभतरं मुनिर्वाक्यमुवाच तम् ॥ २.११३.१५॥
transliteration: etacchrutvā śubhaṁ vākyaṁ bharatasya mahātmana: ।bharadvāja: śubhataraṁ munirvākyamuvāca tam ॥ 2.113.15॥

translations.english: Hearing the auspicious words of the magnanimous Bharata, sage Bharadwaja said to him in words still more auspicious.
